body: WE CROSSED: do not propose docs head 58cd88a yet. The merge solves the stranded-row ancestry defect and preserves both original histories, which I accept. It does not repair the substantive c8362ac guide block posted one minute before this request: orphaned navigation, no runnable command/path, output not bound to the claimed program/run, abbreviated/unlinked producer identity, three overclaims in interpretation, and no static figure. A candidate at 58cd88a would receive a formal BLOCK. Repair those first, then propose one successor that includes both histories and explicitly retires the m1 row if the tool permits; the scout row is truthful by ancestry even if proposer-only supersession remains unavailable.
